paragraphs.text: Nicanor Abundis Fregoso participated in Shipment MZN-10-08 on 2010-08-26. Bruma del Cobre was linked to Shipment MZN-10-08 on 2010-08-26. Shipment MZN-10-08 occurred at Manzanillo on 2010-08-26. A port worker with direct access to the fishing basin reported that Abundis, a recent recruit to the network known on the docks as El Zanate, supervised the loading of 250 kg of cocaine onto a fishing vessel for a run up the coast and onward to Los Angeles. The worker stated that the load had arrived at the basin in a refrigerated van during the early morning and was transferred by hand.

Pesquero Oro Viejo was involved in Shipment MZN-10-08 on 2010-08-26. Nicanor Abundis Fregoso used DEMO-TEL-00149 on 2010-08-26. Shipment MZN-10-08 transited Manzanillo port plaza on 2010-08-26. The worker identified the vessel by name and described it as a converted shrimp boat that had changed owners the previous year. The telephone identifier was one the worker had seen Abundis use to coordinate with the van driver. The worker did not see the vessel depart and could not say whether it was met at sea.

Bruma del Cobre controlled Manzanillo port plaza from 2010-03-14 until 2014-08-02. Rogelio Anzures Tapia led Bruma del Cobre from 2010-03-14 until 2014-08-02. Nicanor Abundis Fregoso was a member of Bruma del Cobre from 2010-06-27 until 2027-01-01. The worker stated that Abundis had joined the network in the summer and was being tested with increasingly large loads. The worker described Anzures as the person who approved the use of the vessel. The reporting office assesses the worker as having direct access and a record of accurate reporting on the basin.
